rows.text: The single biggest mistake a new pilot makes with Muldrotha is treating her as an expensive six-mana beater rather than an engine that resets upon re-entering. Muldrotha allows you to play one land and cast one permanent of *each* permanent type from your graveyard during each of your turns. However, if Muldrotha is blinked or recast (via Displacer Kitten, Phantasmal Image, or Kaya's Ghostform), she enters as a new object, immediately refreshing your permissions for every permanent type that turn. Furthermore, Command Beacon bypasses commander tax entirely: you can sacrifice Command Beacon to put Muldrotha into your hand, cast her for her base six mana, and immediately play Command Beacon right back out of your graveyard as your land drop.

guide.title: The Gravetide avatar and permanent recursion

rows.name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
rows.text: Cast for {3}{B}{G}{U}. Allows you to play a land and cast a permanent of each permanent type (creature, artifact, enchantment, planeswalker, battle) from your graveyard during each of your turns.

rows.name: Command Beacon
rows.text: Taps and sacrifices to put Muldrotha into your hand from the command zone, bypassing commander tax completely. Muldrotha then replays Command Beacon from your graveyard every turn.

rows.name: Secrets of the Dead
rows.text: Two-mana enchantment that draws a card whenever you cast a spell from your graveyard, turning Muldrotha's recursive plays into an avalanche of card advantage.

rows.name: River Kelpie
rows.text: Draws a card whenever a spell or card is cast from a graveyard or enters the battlefield from a graveyard.

rows.name: Six
rows.text: Creature that attacks to mill three cards and returns a nonland permanent to your hand, while granting all nonland permanents in your graveyard retrace.

rows.name: Phantasmal Image
rows.text: Two-mana clone that copies Muldrotha; legend rule sends the original to the graveyard, allowing you to recast Muldrotha and reset all permanent cast permissions.

rows.name: Survival of the Fittest
rows.text: The premier creature toolbox. Discard any creature for {G} to search for another creature; Muldrotha can immediately cast the discarded creature from your graveyard.

rows.name: Hermit Druid
rows.text: Activates for {G} to reveal cards until hitting a basic land, dumping massive chunks of your library directly into your graveyard.

rows.name: Stitcher's Supplier
rows.text: Mills three cards on entry and three on death, providing six cards in the graveyard for just one black mana; recastable every turn.

rows.name: Hedron Crab
rows.text: Mills three cards on each land drop, rapidly stocking your graveyard off fetchlands and exploration plays.

rows.name: Mesmeric Orb
rows.text: Forces each player to mill a card whenever a permanent untaps, filling your graveyard at blazing speed while disrupting opponents.

rows.name: Ripples of Undeath
rows.text: Enchantment that mills three cards during each upkeep and allows you to pay 1 life and {1} to put one milled card into your hand.

rows.name: Altar of Dementia
rows.text: Sacrifice outlet that mills target player equal to the sacrificed creature's power, fueling your own graveyard or milling opponents out.

rows.name: Entomb
rows.text: One-mana instant putting any card from your library directly into your graveyard.

rows.name: Buried Alive
rows.text: Three-mana sorcery tutoring up to three creature cards directly into your graveyard.

rows.name: Unmarked Grave
rows.text: Two-mana sorcery searching for any nonlegendary card and putting it into your graveyard.

rows.name: Gravebreaker Lamia
rows.text: Puts any card from your library into your graveyard on entry, and reduces the mana cost of spells you cast from your graveyard by {1}.

guide.title: The lockdown suite and recursive removal

rows.name: Spore Frog
rows.text: The iconic Muldrotha fog lock. Sacrifice Spore Frog to prevent all combat damage this turn, then recast it from your graveyard on your turn for {G}.

rows.name: Haywire Mite
rows.text: Artifact creature that sacrifices for {1} to exile target noncreature artifact or enchantment and gain 2 life; recastable every turn.

rows.name: Accursed Marauder
rows.text: Forces each player to sacrifice a nontoken creature on entry; recast each turn to relentlessly grind down opposing boards.

rows.name: Plaguecrafter
rows.text: Forces each player to sacrifice a creature or planeswalker, or discard a card; recast every turn.

rows.name: Glen Elendra Archmage
rows.text: Negates noncreature spells for {U}; persist brings her back, and Muldrotha recasts her fresh when she dies.

rows.name: Siren Stormtamer
rows.text: One-mana flyer that sacrifices to counter any spell or ability targeting you or a permanent you control.

rows.name: Seal of Primordium
rows.text: Enchantment that sits on the battlefield and sacrifices at instant speed to destroy an artifact or enchantment; recast each turn.

rows.name: Seal of Removal
rows.text: Enchantment that sacrifices at instant speed to bounce any creature; recast each turn to protect Muldrotha or disrupt opponents.

rows.name: Pernicious Deed
rows.text: Scalable enchantment sweeper that blows up all artifacts, creatures, and enchantments with mana value X or less; recast each turn.

rows.name: Oko, Thief of Crowns
rows.text: Three-mana planeswalker that neutralizes opposing commanders by turning them into vanilla 3/3 Elks; recastable from your graveyard.

rows.name: Displacer Kitten + Lotus Petal + Muldrotha, the Gravetide
rows.text: Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard with Muldrotha. Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha and resetting her permanent-type cast permissions. Lotus Petal enters and is sacrificed for one mana. Repeat infinitely for infinite mana of all colors, then cast every permanent in your graveyard repeatedly to win with Syr Konrad or Marionette Apprentice.

rows.name: Kaya's Ghostform + Phyrexian Altar + Muldrotha, the Gravetide
rows.text: Enchant Muldrotha with Kaya's Ghostform and sacrifice Muldrotha to Phyrexian Altar for {B}. Ghostform returns Muldrotha to the battlefield as a new object, resetting her cast permissions. Spend the {B} to recast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard onto Muldrotha. Repeat infinitely for infinite death and ETB triggers, draining the table with Syr Konrad, Marionette Apprentice, or The Meathook Massacre.
In accordance with Bracket 3 rules, two-card combos are reserved for turn 6 or later. Early turns focus on ramping, filling the graveyard, and establishing recursive control.

rows.name: Syr Konrad, the Grim
rows.text: Deals 1 damage to each opponent whenever another creature dies, is milled from a library, or leaves your graveyard, rapidly burning the table.

rows.name: Marionette Apprentice
rows.text: Pings each opponent for 1 life whenever an artifact or creature you control dies, converting infinite sacrifice loops into lethal table drain.

rows.name: The Meathook Massacre
rows.text: Acts as an asymmetric creature wipe on entry and drains each opponent for 1 life whenever your creatures die in sacrifice loops.

rows.name: The Gitrog Monster
rows.text: Grants an extra land play each turn and draws a card whenever a land card is put into your graveyard from anywhere.

rows.name: Life from the Loam
rows.text: Dredges three cards and returns up to three land cards from your graveyard to your hand for {1}{G}.

rows.name: Dakmor Salvage
rows.text: Land that dredges two cards whenever you would draw, creating endless card draw and dredge loops with The Gitrog Monster.

rows.name: Aftermath Analyst
rows.text: Mills three cards on entry and sacrifices to return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

rows.name: Exploration
rows.text: One-mana enchantment allowing an additional land play on each of your turns, weaponizing Muldrotha's graveyard land drop.

rows.name: Birds of Paradise
rows.text: Classic one-drop mana acceleration producing any color.

rows.name: Delighted Halfling
rows.text: One-drop mana dork producing uncounterable mana for legendary spells.

rows.name: Bloom Tender
rows.text: Two-mana dork that taps for up to three mana (black, green, blue) with Muldrotha on the battlefield.

rows.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
rows.text: Snake that sacrifices to ramp a basic land onto the battlefield; recast each turn with Muldrotha.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: Premier fast mana artifact.

rows.name: Arcane Signet
rows.text: Reliable two-mana rock producing all three Sultai colors.

rows.name: Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: Asymmetric instant-speed blowout bouncing all nonland permanents you don't control.

rows.name: Rhystic Study
rows.text: Relentless card advantage taxing every opponent spell.

rows.name: Toxic Deluge
rows.text: Three-mana sweeper paying life to clear boards through indestructible.

rows.name: Culling Ritual
rows.text: Sweeps all nonland permanents with mana value 2 or less, generating explosive mana to deploy Muldrotha.

rows.name: Mana Drain
rows.text: Two-mana hard counter converting countered spell cost into mana on your next turn.

rows.name: Counterspell
rows.text: Reliable hard counter for two blue mana.

rows.name: Swan Song
rows.text: Efficient one-mana counter for instant, sorcery, or enchantment spells.

rows.name: Assassin's Trophy
rows.text: Two-mana universal spot removal for any permanent.

rows.name: Shifting Woodland
rows.text: Delirium land that pays {2}{G}{G} to become a copy of any permanent card in your graveyard until end of turn.

rows.name: Boseiju, Who Endures
rows.text: Channel ability destroying an artifact, enchantment, or nonbasic land without being cast as a spell.

rows.name: Otawara, Soaring City
rows.text: Channel ability bouncing target creature, artifact, enchantment, or planeswalker.

rows.name: Takenuma, Abandoned Mire
rows.text: Channel ability that mills three cards and returns a creature or planeswalker from your graveyard to your hand.

Look for opening hands with 2 to 3 lands, cheap mana acceleration (Birds of Paradise, Delighted Halfling, Sol Ring, Sakura-Tribe Elder), and an early self-mill engine or tutor (Stitcher's Supplier, Hedron Crab, Hermit Druid, Entomb, Survival of the Fittest).
On turns 1 through 3, prioritize mana ramp and stocking your graveyard with diverse permanent types.

On turn 4 or 5, cast Muldrotha, the Gravetide. If you have open mana or 0-mana permanents (Lotus Petal, Spore Frog, Kaya's Ghostform), cast them immediately to protect Muldrotha and lock out opposing combat.
Throughout the midgame, loop Spore Frog to nullify enemy combat, use Haywire Mite and Plaguecrafter to grind away opposing boards, and draw cards with Secrets of the Dead.
On turn 6 or later, execute your finish using the Displacer Kitten + Lotus Petal loop, the Kaya's Ghostform + Phyrexian Altar loop, or an Altar of Dementia table mill.
